subject: ACK chain hook (a9f7) + async probe follows 0108; my bridge hunk reverted
body:
1) The executor hook is in compute_frontend.m teguExecute:
- n2mb_chain_begin is called after the async decision when count>0.
- A generic draw/batch reply id 0 counts as 'in chain' only while chain!=0.
- n2mb_chain_end runs after the job loop, also on failure; its error fails the command.
- The command's completion seq is max(last nonzero reply id, chain id). It drives the deferred WAIT_SEQ and the early-scheduled path.
Default off, so behaviour is unchanged.
Please make sure the chain job's write_mask declares the imported display surface. Kernel 0097(c) swap hold needs it once early scheduling fires.

2) Async probe:
- Per KA 0108, I REVERTED my async_probe change. nord2_metal_bridge.c has only a comment change now; semantics are the original (state 4 required).
- P11+ (0108) goes async. P8-P10 (WAIT_SEQ(0)=NotFound) stay synchronous with one WAIT per job, exactly as on C6o.
- The test fake now answers seq 0 as 0108 does. It has an opt-in seq0_notfound pre-0108 model, plus a bridge test asserting it stays synchronous (3 draws -> 3 WAITs, 0 WAIT_SEQ).

3) A time-model fake (submit_us/gpu_us; opt-in, default 0) was added for frame_bench.
Gates are running.
